comments.author: Dreamt_Up_Games
comments.body: I’ve been in the video games industry for a long time (not as a dev but professionally) and the way how AI in game dev is getting hated on reminds me on how free to play was talked about when the model first started becoming popular in the west. There were lots of crappy games put out using the business model and it took some awesome high production value games to come out to start changing the opinion and realizing that free to play is a business model not a game design principle just like AI is a tool and a game design paradigm.
